title: Learning-Guided Sparsification of Dynamic Graphs in Robotic Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2604.16509v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many robotic exploration algorithms rely on graph structures for frontier-based exploration and dynamic path planning. However, these graphs grow rapidly, accumulating redundant information and impacting performance. We present a hybrid transformer-based framework trained with Proximal Policy Optimization which complements exploration algorithms by pruning these graphs during exploration, limiting their growth and reducing the accumulation of excess information. The framework was evaluated on simulations of a robotic agent using Rapidly-Exploring Random Trees to carry out frontier-based exploration, where the learned policy reduces graph size by up to 96%. We find preliminary evidence that our framework enables effective, generalizable exploration under reduced information density, consistently outperforming the randomly pruned baseline and improving both exploration efficiency and computational efficiency beyond the unpruned b

translated_title: 学习引导的机器人探索中动态图稀疏化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.16509v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：许多机器人探索算法依赖图结构进行基于前沿的探索和动态路径规划。然而，这些图会迅速增长，积累冗余信息并影响性能。我们提出了一种基于混合变换器的框架，该框架使用近端策略优化进行训练，通过探索过程中剪枝这些图来补充探索算法，限制其增长并减少多余信息的积累。该框架在模拟机器人代理使用快速探索随机树进行基于前沿的探索时进行了评估，学习策略将图大小减少了高达96%。我们初步发现，该框架能够在降低信息密度的情况下实现有效且可泛化的探索，始终优于随机剪枝的基线，并在探索效率和计算效率上超越未剪枝的基准。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于变换器和强化学习的动态图剪枝框架，能在机器人探索中显著减少图规模（高达96%），同时提升探索与计算效率，优于随机剪枝和未剪枝方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a transformer-based reinforcement learning framework for dynamic graph pruning in robotic exploration, reducing graph size by up to 96% while improving exploration and computational efficiency over random pruning and unpruned baselines.
